title: Stadtwerk Mauer Energy Sharing collective approval seed

demoTenant.description: Virtual Stadtwerk Mauer demo tenant; collective, participant, metering, contract, allocation, A96, billing and settlement values are synthetic review data.

publicContextLayer.description: Read-only municipal, regulatory, MaStR, OSM or comparable public context already blended into the virtual Stadtwerk. Demo reset flows must not mutate this layer.

syntheticTenantSeed.description: Invented demo collective, operator, participant-boundary, metering, contract, consent, market-role and evidence-gap markers for stadtwerk-mauer.

sandboxRuntimeArtifact.description: Resettable output from Cernion/Rundeck demo verification runs, separate from public context baselines.

roles.responsibility: Owns the synthetic collective approval review and decides whether the case is ready for review or still an evidence gap.
Builds deterministic collective approval rows from existing Blueprint-Pack and dashboard read models.
Provides synthetic participant-boundary and metering-concept markers without onboarding participants or changing meters.
Provides contract, consent and market-role review context without legal approval, customer communication or contract signing.
Marks A96, allocation, billing and settlement evidence gaps without executing export, allocation, billing or settlement.
Provides grid-operations plausibility context without switching, control, MaKo or device action.
Receives review-readiness and governance-boundary context without approving a real customer or tenant project.
Receives non-binding commercial review context without tariff, billing, settlement or customer-facing action.

evidenceRequirements.enablesDossierAddition: Adds the synthetic collective and pilot boundary as public-safe review material, not as a real customer project.
Adds operator ownership, participant boundary and governance scope once tenant-provided review evidence exists.
Adds the metering concept readiness statement without creating, changing or controlling metering assets.
Adds contract, consent and market-role review readiness without customer communication or contract signing.
Adds allocation, A96, billing and settlement evidence-gap closure as review evidence only, never execution.
Adds the ready-for-review or evidence-gap classification and the next safe governance gate.
